span.term: Subtly cued racial stereotypes lower perceived deservingness of welfare recipients, and that reduced deservingness in turn reduces support for welfare spending.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Colorblind norms in liberal political culture suppress discussion of black Americans' outcomes, so liberals lack ready structural explanations and cannot rebut appeals that tie those outcomes to racial stereotypes.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Repeated exposure to racialized welfare rhetoric builds chronic race-policy associations among moderates and conservatives, leaving no room for a novel appeal to strengthen the link further.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE PAPER FLAGS ITS OWN CENTRAL FINDING AS UNPREDICTED, IN THE ABSTRACT, AND SUPPLIES THE GROUND FOR BELIEVING IT ANYWAY IN THE SAME SENTENCE: **THAT DOG-WHISTLE EFFECTS WOULD BE CONCENTRATED AMONG LIBERALS WAS NOT PREDICTED IN ADVANCE**, but this finding appears across two experiments testing effects of racial appeals in policy domains - welfare and gun control - **THAT DIFFER IN THE EXTENT AND WAYS THEY HAVE BEEN PREVIOUSLY RACIALIZED**. The replication is offered as the answer to the post-hoc objection, and the two domains are chosen for their difference rather than their similarity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE MODERATOR IS MEASURED TWO WEEKS BEFORE THE TREATMENT, which is what lets it be read as a disposition the message ACTS ON rather than an attitude the message produced: white Americans' racial attitudes were measured **TWO WEEKS BEFORE** they read political messages in which Quotation withheld at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AND THE CONTROL CONDITION IS REPORTED AS PARTLY FAILING ITS OWN THEORY: the same group **OCCASIONALLY RESPONDED TO EXPLICIT RACIAL APPEALS EVEN THOUGH THESE APPEALS WERE RECOGNIZED AS RACIALLY INSENSITIVE**. On the dog-whistle account an explicit appeal should be neutralised by the egalitarian norm the moment it is recognised, so a recognised appeal that still moves opinion is a result against the mechanism, reported by its own testers
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the dog-whistle hypothesis / racial priming theory - ONE THEORY UNDER TWO NAMES, and this paper is where the corpus can see it, because the equivalence is stated rather than inferred: `the dog-whistle hypothesis, or racial priming theory`. The first name comes from political communication, the second from political psychology
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: implicit versus explicit, as this literature means it - not about the SUBJECT'S awareness of being influenced, as in the media-priming records, but about whether the MESSAGE names its racial content. The condition is a property of the stimulus, and the theory's prediction is that only the unnamed version can work
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an unpredicted finding, marked as one BY THE AUTHORS IN THE ABSTRACT - and given, in the same sentence, the reason it should still be believed: it appears across two experiments in policy domains that differ in how far they have been racialized. A post-hoc result and its own robustness argument, stated together

The theory predicts only the unnamed version can work · strength of the relation: 0.9 — Worth setting beside Hoewe2020, where `implicit` is a property of the CONSUMER'S processing. Same word, different bearer.

span.label: In Study 1, white participants who read Reagan's implicit racial appeal opposing welfare reported significantly less support for welfare than those who read a race-neutral control message.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The welfare dog-whistle effect was concentrated among self-identified liberals high in racial resentment, who became less supportive of welfare after the implicit appeal.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Study 2 replicated the ideology-conditioned pattern in a different policy domain: the implicit appeal strengthened the link between prior racial attitudes and gun-control support among liberals only.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In Study 2 the implicit appeal also harnessed explicit racial prejudice, making prejudiced liberals more supportive of gun control than in the control condition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Contrary to racial priming theory, explicit racial appeals were not less effective than implicit ones at increasing the influence of racial attitudes on policy views.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Among political moderates the implicit pro-gun-control appeal backfired, lowering gun-control support among the most racially prejudiced rather than raising it.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In 2016 ANES data, white liberals high in racial resentment were the group most likely to have switched from Obama in 2012 to Trump in 2016.
span.note: retracted: RE-GROUNDED - THE POINTER WAS WRONG, NOT THE CLAIM. The old evidence was verbatim, anchored and correctly cut, and it contained NONE of this claim's numbers (2012, 2016). The paper states the claim in one sentence elsewhere and the tagger did not use it. CLAUDE_B, 2026-08-23: `WE HAVE SPENT THE DAY VERIFYING THAT QUOTES ARE REAL AND NONE OF IT ASKS WHETHER THEY ARE RELEVANT.` Confirmed by reading the claim, the old span and the candidate together; the candidate carries every number AND the claim's own content words.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
